name: Reaction Video
description: Split-screen or picture-in-picture reaction format with commentary overlaid. Subject: viral videos, movie clips, news events, or other people's content.
voice_style: expressive, reactive, authentic — gasp, laugh, and think aloud; genuine first-take energy
music_mood: background: the source video audio plays naturally; overlay music only during commentary pauses

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Wait. Wait wait wait. Are you seeing this? Rewind. Rewind it again.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person sitting in front of phone/computer, looking shocked, hand covering mouth, split-screen with video content in corner
scene_sequence.camera_movement: snap zoom on reaction face, split-screen composition with source content in PiP corner
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: ring light as key light on face, screen glow filling frame, slightly dim background to center reaction face
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: PiP/split-screen aesthetic is the core format; reaction face must be bright and clear against the dark background

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: [Reacting throughout] — pointing at screen — Oh my god, no. No way. Did you — did you see what they just did?! Okay I need a second. Pause it. I need to process this.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at PiP screen, laughing or jaw-dropping, scrolling comments visible, genuine shock/joy expressions
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up static on face, cuts to comment scroll insert, back to face reaction
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: ring light bright and even on face, screen glow as secondary fill, natural expression colors
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Genuine expression is the content — bright ring light ensures face reads clearly at all times during reaction

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Here's the thing though — this is fake. I'm pretty sure this is staged. Look at the camera angle. But even if it's real — the reaction alone is worth the watch.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person breaking down evidence, circling things on screen with finger, analytical expression returning, slight grin
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, slight push-in on analytical beat, steady hold
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: slightly brighter/key light for analytical mode, slightly cooler tones, more serious energy
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Analytical beat shift — subtle lighting shift from shock to thought signals the mode change without words

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Follow for more reactions — I do these every single day. Drop a comment below and tell me what video you want me to react to next.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person waving at camera, smile, subscribe text overlay, duo-lens setup visible showing both reaction and source content
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, warm friendly wave gesture, energetic finish
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm bright light on wave/finish, energetic warm tones
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Energy bump on outro — subscriber acquisition moment; wave gesture adds personality
